comment: Cornerman drop-worker model endpoint config (Slice 2). Deploy the live copy to C:\lifepunch\cornerman\config\model-endpoints.json on Green. LOCALHOST ONLY: the worker refuses (in code) any URL that does not start with http://127.0.0.1: or http://localhost: -- no cloud fallback, no egress. A model call additionally requires the -EnableModelCall worker switch AND packet modelCall.enabled=true (double opt-in). routes maps routeTag -> exact LM Studio model id; a routed/required model missing from /v1/models ALWAYS fails closed (no substitution, allowFallback ignored in Slice 2). AUTO OK is never routed to a Green model.
